title: Turn a model proposal into an application permit
description: Bind identity and resource scope, then decide whether approval, idempotency, and reconciliation make the proposed tool call safe to execute.

operations.label: Search tenant policy
operations.detail: Read indexed policy passages for the authenticated tenant.
operations.safeResult: The search is constrained to the caller's tenant and returns a bounded result.
operations.unsafeResult: The proposal can read policy data outside the caller's authorized boundary.

operations.label: Refund one payment
operations.detail: Create a customer-visible financial side effect for one payment resource.
operations.safeResult: The refund is authorized, approved, deduplicated, and reconciled before any retry.
operations.unsafeResult: The crew can issue an unauthorized or duplicate refund when a response is lost.

operations.label: Send scheduled digest
operations.detail: A service job sends one tenant-scoped digest for a known schedule window.
operations.safeResult: The service principal can send one digest per tenant and schedule window.
operations.unsafeResult: The job can cross tenant boundaries or send the same digest multiple times.

operations.label: Export customer record
operations.detail: Return sensitive data for one customer after an explicit user decision.
operations.safeResult: The export is limited to one authorized resource and released after approval.
operations.unsafeResult: Sensitive customer data can leave the resource boundary without a trusted approval.
